draft.event_evidence: UGC Notification regarding Specification of Degrees Fifth Amendment published in the Gazette of India on 27th August 2026.
draft.related_notice: UGC Gazette Notification on Specification of Degrees dated 5th July 2014
draft.change_reason: Regulatory alignment with the National Commission for Allied and Healthcare Professions (NCAHP) and restructuring of M.PT and M.OT degree specializations.
important_dates: 2026-08-27: Date of publication in the Official Gazette
2026-07-03: NCAHP communication regarding degree nomenclature for Academic Year 2026-27
draft.summary: The UGC has issued the Fifth Amendment to the Specification of Degrees notification, effective from 27th August 2026. This amendment updates degree nomenclatures and structures for Allied and Healthcare professions under the NCAHP purview. Notably, M.PT and M.OT degrees must now be awarded with specific specializations rather than as generalized degrees for admissions from the 2026-27 Academic Year onwards.
